profile.headline: Web Developer at Sun & Ski Sports
profile.summary: I am a graduate from Trinity University with a major in Computer Science and a minor in New Media. I am a web developer with nearly 4 years of experience building web pages and web applications using a variety of technologies and content management systems. I am currently part of Sun and Ski Sports as a Web Developer.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.insights: Stibo Systems MDM, HTML5 and +4 skills

positions.title: Contract Developer
positions.description:
Work with team members to help build a conceptualized brand for clients' websites
using web languages such as HTML, XML, XSLT, CSS (including LESS & SASS) and
JavaScript and content management systems including SAM, Drupal, WordPress and
Sitecore. 
• Implement style and content changes to the WillScot website using Sitecore
and Unbounce
• Delivered multiple email signature generators with the use of JavaScript ES6
• Taught and presented the basics of React to the development team

positions.title: Web Developer Intern
positions.description:
Assist the web development team in a variety of web development projects. Implement concepts and designs using a variety of web languages and content management systems.
-Enabled the Disasters LLC project to go live as the main web developer with the use of SAM
-Delivered multiple email signature generators with the use of JavaScript ES6
-Aided in the development of an AWS Lambda Application to synchronize information between HubSpot and Workamajig using NodeJS
-Enforced accessible and responsive web development practices for the BrandExtract, Disasters LLC and Crestwood LP websites
-Performed a variety of bug fixes across the web projects developed by the team

positions.title: Federal Work Study Student Assistant
positions.description: Self-directed coding program to learn JavaScript and its libraries. Each week assistants complete online courses and independent studies as well as participate in occasional discussions, and develop applications if requested.

positions.title: Mobile Application Developer Intern
positions.description:
-Designed and developed a mobile application with Java through Android Studio
-Engaged in biweekly meetings with peers to discuss progress and tasks at hand
-Organized layout of application using wireframes designed in Balsamiq

projects.title: Web Design Project
projects.description:
-Created a website from scratch using HTML and CSS from information obtained from a client
-Implemented structure of the web pages using flexbox
-Designed wireframes prior to coding to plan out the initial design

projects.title: Group 3D Racing Game
projects.description:
-Collaborated with a group of nine to develop a multi-player racing game
-Modeled and textured background elements such as trees and houses using Maya
-Designed UI elements such as a speedometer in Adobe Photoshop
